name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: World's largest government-funded health assurance scheme providing cashless secondary & tertiary hospital care.
incomeThreshold: Annual household income <= ₹1,20,000 or SECC 2011 deprived rural household
eligibilityCriteria: Rural households with D1-D7 deprivation indicators under SECC 2011
Families holding BPL / Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) ration card
Annual family income up to ₹1.2 Lakhs (or state-specific expanded criteria up to ₹3.13 Lakhs in MH Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana)
benefits: Cashless hospitalization across 28,000+ impaneled public and private secondary/tertiary hospitals nationwide.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
description: Safe motherhood intervention under the National Health Mission promoting institutional delivery among poor pregnant women.
incomeThreshold: Pregnant women belonging to BPL/SC/ST households or general BPL cards
eligibilityCriteria: Pregnant women aged 19 years or above delivering in public health centers or accredited private hospitals
BPL card holders, SC/ST community members in low-performing states (LPS)
Covers up to first two live births for general BPL, unlimited for SC/ST/LPS
benefits: Direct cash transfer to mother's bank account, free emergency transport via 108 ambulance, free post-delivery medicines & diet.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Maternity benefit cash incentive program under Ministry of Women and Child Development.
coverageAmount: ₹5,000 in two installments (First child) / ₹6,000 (Second child if female)
incomeThreshold: Annual family income < ₹8,00,000 (EWS / BPL / MGNREGA Job Card / e-Shram card holders)
eligibilityCriteria: Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM) for the first living child
Must register pregnancy early at Anganwadi Centre / PHC within 560 days of LMP
Must undergo at least one Antenatal Check-up (ANC) and complete child immunization
benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) cash installments into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts to compensate wage loss during maternity.

name: NHM Free Drugs and Diagnostics Service Initiative
description: National Health Mission mandate ensuring zero out-of-pocket expenditure for essential healthcare at public facilities.
incomeThreshold: Universal access — No income threshold or ration card requirement
eligibilityCriteria: All Indian citizens visiting Sub-Centres, Primary Health Centres (PHC), Community Health Centres (CHC), and District Hospitals
Includes free blood supply, X-ray, ECG, basic blood panels, and emergency ambulance transport (108)
benefits: Complete elimination of out-of-pocket expenditure for NLEM essential medicines and essential lab diagnostics.

name: Intensified Mission Indradhanush (IMI 5.0)
description: Flagship universal immunization campaign targeting unreached children and pregnant women.
incomeThreshold: Universal — Free for all infants and pregnant women
eligibilityCriteria: Children up to 5 years of age who have missed routine immunizations
benefits: Full protection against 12 vaccine-preventable diseases including Polio, Measles, Rubella, Hepatitis B, Rotavirus, and DPT.
